name: Severity
description: How serious the threat to life or property is, using the same codes as CAP 1.2 (OASIS).

hasDefinedTerm.name: Extreme
hasDefinedTerm.description: An extraordinary threat to life or property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Severe
hasDefinedTerm.description: A significant threat to life or property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Moderate
hasDefinedTerm.description: A possible threat to life or property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Minor
hasDefinedTerm.description: Little to no known threat to life or property.
